verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Workable publishes an endpoint-by-endpoint API reference at workable.readme.io, with scopes and descriptions, plus llms.txt and markdown versions. Nothing in the pack shows that this reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as a try-it console or executable requests, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. A static reference is adjacent to this story but does not deliver the interactive, runnable part.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
